return_status_requested: Your return {return_id} for order {order_id} was requested on {date}. Once noon receives and checks the item, the refund starts.
return_status_refund_approved: Your return {return_id} for order {order_id} passed the check and your refund of EGP {amount} is approved. It will be sent to {destination}.
return_status_refund_initiated: Your refund of EGP {amount} for return {return_id} (order {order_id}) was started on {date}. It will be sent to {destination}.
return_status_refunded: Your refund of EGP {amount} for return {return_id} (order {order_id}) was completed. It was sent to {destination}.
return_status_partially_refunded: Your return {return_id} (order {order_id}) was partly refunded: EGP {amount} was sent to {destination}. Some fees are not refundable.
return_status_rejected_in_hub: Your return {return_id} for order {order_id} did not pass the check at the hub, so no refund was made. I can connect you with a colleague to look into it.
return_none: I can't see a return for order {order_id}. If you would like to return an item, just tell me.
